sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Tests for money and megaproject rules
sections.what: Checks that money text such as US$1.2 billion or a rupee crore amount is read exactly, without estimation. Checks that tiny or unitless amounts are rejected, that megaprojects need at least one billion dollars and exclude company plans, and that the cost overrun percentage is unaffected by currency when both figures share one currency.
sections.why: These tests protect exact capex parsing, which the rest of the app treats as fact.
sections.watch_out: One test calls the exchange rate helper through a dynamic import, so moving that file would break the test.

summary: Tests for reading money amounts, megaproject status and cost overrun percentages.
purpose: Confirms that capex figures are read exactly as stated and that small or unitless figures are rejected.
why: Likely reason: capex figures are shown as sourced facts, so a parsing mistake would mislead readers.
how: 1. Check money formats that should be accepted. 2. Check formats that should be rejected. 3. Check the megaproject rules. 4. Check the overrun percentage with and without a shared currency.
inputs: Sample text and sample figures written in the test file.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: Tests cover only the listed examples, so an unusual format or new currency is not checked.
debug: Run the test file and read the expected value in the failing assertion. If a money test fails, check the parser in the facts file.
